stories.title: ¿Puede la izquierda ganar las elecciones? Lo que dicen las encuestas

en.title: Can the left win the elections? What the polls say
en.summary: An electoral campaign has begun with housing as a central issue. Polling data is being examined to assess the left's chances in the upcoming elections.

stories.title: Feijóo no teme otra remontada de Sánchez y niega el paralelismo con las elecciones de 2023

en.title: Feijóo does not fear another comeback by Sánchez and denies parallel with 2023 elections
en.summary: Ayuso launched a pre-campaign, setting the tone for the conservative party's strategy. Feijóo dismissed comparisons to the 2023 electoral results and expressed confidence in his position.

stories.title: Así gestó Sánchez el adelanto electoral: “Este Congreso no nos vale, tenemos que ir a elecciones, podemos ganar”

en.title: How Sánchez managed the early election call: "This Congress doesn't work for us, we have to go to elections, we can win"
en.summary: The president and his inner circle decided on calling early elections after learning that the Junts party would not support key measures, viewing an election as the best path forward.

stories.title: Todos los proyectos que caen con las nuevas elecciones tras una legislatura con 22 leyes y 43 decretos

en.title: All the projects that fall with the new elections after a legislature with 22 laws and 43 decrees
en.summary: The government plans to approve housing and disaster relief decrees through the permanent delegation before elections. Multiple legislative initiatives from the parliamentary term will be halted.

stories.title: Medvedev, expulsado del torneo de Pekín por un pelotazo a un espectador

en.title: Medvedev expelled from Beijing tournament for hitting ball at spectator
en.summary: Tennis player Daniil Medvedev was immediately disqualified from the Beijing ATP 500 tournament after hitting a ball that struck a spectator in the head during his match against Novak Djokovic.

stories.title: El adelanto electoral no frena las movilizaciones: miles de personas llaman en Barcelona a la huelga general por la vivienda

en.title: Early elections fail to stop mobilizations: thousands in Barcelona call for general strike over housing
en.summary: A large housing protest march in Barcelona exceeded organizer expectations and required route changes. Clashes with police and property damage occurred at the march's end.

stories.title: La protesta por la crisis de la vivienda acaba con incidentes y cargas policiales en el centro de Barcelona

en.title: Protest over housing crisis ends with incidents and police charges in central Barcelona
en.summary: Thousands of people demonstrated peacefully in Barcelona to demand a general strike, but clashes erupted at the end of the march.

stories.title: UGT y CC.OO. convocan huelga general antes de la campaña electoral

en.title: UGT and CC.OO. call for general strike before electoral campaign
en.summary: The two major unions are finalizing details for a protest that may include partial work stoppages ahead of elections.

stories.title: Miles de personas llaman a la huelga general por la vivienda en Barcelona: “Esto acaba de empezar”

en.title: Thousands call for general strike over housing in Barcelona: "This is just beginning"
en.summary: The Barcelona tenants union calls to paralyze the country and will coordinate with major unions to set a date for the general strike.

stories.title: Los sindicatos UGT y CC OO irán a la huelga general por la crisis de la vivienda

en.title: Unions UGT and CC OO will strike over housing crisis
en.summary: Major Spanish unions UGT and CC OO have called a general strike to address the housing crisis, responding to demands from tenant organizations and mass protests. The strike is scheduled shortly before general elections.

stories.title: Medvedev, descalificado en semifinales del Abierto de China tras dar un pelotazo a un espectador

en.title: Medvedev disqualified in Chinese Open semifinals after hitting spectator with ball
en.summary: Russian player Medvedev, ranked fifth in the world, was disqualified from the Chinese Open semifinals after striking a spectator with a ball. The incident occurred while he was losing the match.

stories.title: Feijóo cree que Sánchez convoca elecciones por “miedo a la maraña de casos de corrupción”

en.title: Feijóo believes Sánchez calls elections out of "fear of corruption cases"
en.summary: The PP leader argues the government president called elections due to corruption concerns and deserves electoral punishment.

stories.title: La herencia envenenada de Sánchez en la vivienda

en.title: Sánchez's poisoned inheritance in housing
en.summary: The Spanish real estate market functioned significantly better when Sánchez took office than it does currently.

stories.title: Los grandes inversores vigilan los cambios regulatorios

en.title: Large investors monitor regulatory changes
en.summary: Major investors are watching regulatory shifts and tax policies ahead of November 29 elections. The stock market remains stable with expectations that a different government would not significantly alter overall market performance, though valuations in energy, banking, and real estate investment trusts could change.

stories.title: Sánchez cierra una legislatura que aleja a España de EEUU y la acerca a China

en.title: Sánchez closes a term that distances Spain from the US and brings it closer to China
en.summary: Spain's president has strengthened trade with China following disputes with Trump, moved slowly on military spending for NATO, and faced criticism over migration management during his term.

stories.title: Presupuestos, quita de deuda y financiación autonómica caen tras el fin de la legislatura

en.title: Budgets, debt relief and regional financing suspended after end of legislative term
en.summary: The election call leaves key government measures and reforms uncertain, with the administration completing its first term without presenting a national budget proposal.

stories.title: Sánchez diseña su propia 'kale borroka' para el día después

en.title: Sánchez designs his own 'kale borroka' for the day after
en.summary: The president has called elections while planning two decrees to pass through the Permanent Delegation, following a strategy of implementing measures before a potential government change.
